title: when building a UI brief, check that every path the brief tells the role to write is inside the temp directory, the renders directory or the report path

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The UI pass reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) in ork run ork-20261119-234354-c0f6, item S475. At that time the brief told the role to run `-renders` into a directory outside the set of paths the role was allowed to write. Nothing in the code checked the brief against that set, so a person found the mismatch in a live run.

The owner decided on 2026-11-28 (session 8d711f67, 'Test only') that `BuildBrief` stays as it is. A test builds the brief for every role and vendor and checks that each path the brief tells the role to write is inside TempDir, the renders directory, ReportPath or the local implementer ProgressFile. A later edit to a brief or a role prompt that names a write target outside that set then fails a test, not a run.

Owner decisions, 2026-11-28: adj 676 (a test over built briefs; BuildBrief unchanged) and adj 683 (allowed paths: TempDir, renders directory, ReportPath, ProgressFile, TMPDir, and the worktree for implementer, lead and part).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/brief_lint_test.go` (new test-only write-target lint and matrix)
- `internal/engine/brief.go:177-187` (read only: `processTemp` and the `{{temp_dir}}` / `{{renders_dir}}` fills; unchanged)
- `internal/engine/brief_test.go:380` (read only: `baseBrief`; reused unchanged)

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
These tests are new and initially fail to compile because the test-only helpers do not exist. The built-brief matrix is expected to pass on current BuildBrief once those helpers exist; it guards future regressions.
- `TestBriefWriteTargetsFindsEachWriteInstruction`: fixed text covers bare and single-quoted -renders paths (including spaces), Write the files into the renders directory, Write your progress note now to, Edit and Write under, saves it to, and scratch files in. Paths before the cue and after never/not/no are excluded. Cues are case-insensitive whole words, sentences and lines are isolated, and punctuation is trimmed.
- `TestBriefWritePathsOutsideTheAllowedSetAreFlagged`: reject an outside -renders path and a directory-name prefix sibling; diagnostics name path, role, vendor and allowed set. Accept TempDir/renders, TempDir, TMPDir and descendants, exact ReportPath and ProgressFile, and writable implementer/lead/part worktrees per adj 683. Reject read-only worktrees and descendants of exact-file exceptions.
- `TestBriefWriteTargetsAreInsideTheAllowedSetForEveryRole`: BuildBrief succeeds across the Implement matrix, all extracted targets are allowed, and extraction includes ReportPath, UI renders when present, and ProgressFile when a progress note is present. Uses baseBrief at internal/engine/brief_test.go:380 and BuildBrief fills at internal/engine/brief.go:177-187.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
All changes are in `internal/engine/brief_lint_test.go`. No production code changes.
1. Add `briefWriteTargets(brief string) []string`. For each line, remove backticks and split the line into sentences at ". ". In each sentence, find the write cues (case-insensitive whole words): `write`, `writes`, `edit`, `put`, `save`, `saves`, `-renders`. After each cue, collect the absolute paths that follow it in the same sentence. A path is `'/...'` in single quotes (ShellWord output), or a bare token that starts with `/`, is preceded by the start of the sentence, a space, a quote or `(`, and has trailing `.`, `:` and `,` trimmed. Skip a path when `never`, `not` or `no` stands between the cue and the path. A path before its cue is not collected. A line-per-line scan keeps the reviewer probe recipe's JSON line from being read as an instruction.
2. Add `briefWritePathViolations(in BriefInput, brief string) []error`. The allowed set is `in.TempDir` and anything under it (this covers `TempDir/renders`), `in.TMPDir` and anything under it when it is set, `in.ReportPath` exactly, and `in.ProgressFile` exactly. Compare with `filepath.Rel` so that a prefix match on a sibling name is not inside. A target in `in.Worktree` is also allowed when the role is `implementer` or `part`, `in.Lead` is set and the role is not read-only. Each violation error names the path, the role, the vendor and the allowed set.
3. Add `briefWriteMatrix()` that builds `BriefInput` values from `baseBrief()` with these changes. Set `TMPDir` to `/state/runs/r1/tmp-role/process` and `ProgressFile` to `/state/runs/r1/tmp/progress.md`, so TMPDir and TempDir are not nested. Use the roles implementer, implementer with `Lead` (the lead prompt), part, reviewer, gate, architect, ui, spec-check, spec-check with `Carve`, and spec-draft. Use the vendors claude, claude-local, codex, codex-local, grok and grok-local. Use `ReadOnly` true for all roles and also false for implementer, lead and part. For ui, run `RenderCLI`/`RenderTUI` as true/true and as false/false.
4. Add the three tests from Failing tests. The matrix test builds each brief with `BuildBrief`, reports a build error as a failure that names the role and the vendor, and then calls `briefWritePathViolations`. It also checks the three "extractor found it" requirements. Use `t.Run` per role and vendor.
5. If a real sentence in a role prompt is flagged that is not a write instruction, tighten the cue list or the negation rule in step 1. Do not widen the allowed set in step 2.
6. Run `gofmt -l .` and `go vet ./...`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- Acceptance: a brief that tells a role to run -renders into a path outside TempDir, TMPDir, TempDir/renders, ReportPath and ProgressFile fails TestBriefWritePathsOutsideTheAllowedSetAreFlagged. Every built brief in the matrix passes TestBriefWriteTargetsAreInsideTheAllowedSetForEveryRole. internal/engine/brief.go and the role prompts are unchanged (git -C /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork diff --stat lists only internal/engine/brief_lint_test.go).
- `go test -run TestBriefWriteTargetsFindsEachWriteInstruction ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBriefWritePathsOutsideTheAllowedSetAreFlagged ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test -run TestBriefWriteTargetsAreInsideTheAllowedSetForEveryRole ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test ./internal/engine` passes.
- `go test ./...` passes.
- `go vet ./...` prints nothing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
